data.name: DatabaseFilesIncomplete
data.value: Database '{0}' has a directory without a database in it, or creation stopped before a complete data header. Preserve all files and restore the complete file set from backup. OpenDatabaseAsync requires the original journal and backup; it cannot safely replace a missing sidecar. Only a directory with no complete data header may be cleared with DropDatabaseAsync and created again.

data.name: DatabaseFilesUnrecoverable
data.value: Database '{0}' has missing or unrecoverable storage files. Preserve all files and restore the complete file set from backup. OpenDatabaseAsync requires the original journal and backup; replacing a missing sidecar could discard acknowledged commits or reopen a partially dropped database.
